source: MVP PRD sections 3.2 and 3.5; conventions in README.md

cases.title: PRD example: 1,075 including 7.5% VAT, cost 800, margin 20.0%
Tax-exclusive price with no tax rate on file still calculates
cases.note: An unknown rate must not block a price that is already tax-exclusive.

cases.title: Tax-inclusive price with no tax rate: Unable to Evaluate, never Within
Same 1,000 shelf price looks healthy tax-exclusive but breaches once VAT is removed
cases.note: 1,000 / 1.075 = 930.23; 800 / 930.23 = 0.86, so margin is exactly 14.0%. Using the shelf price would wrongly show 20%.

cases.title: Tax basis not recorded: calculation unavailable
PRD Margin Exposure example: 1,000 with cost 900 is 10.0%, gap 5 points
Margin and markup are different numbers (20% margin = 25% markup)
Zero cost: margin 100%, markup unavailable
Zero price: margin unavailable, markup -100%
Price below cost gives a negative margin, shown as it is
No applicable cost: every cost metric unavailable, guardrail Unable to Evaluate
Very large amounts keep exact precision
PRD J1: cost 900, target margin 18%, round to nearest 10 gives 1,100 (+10%, 18.2%)
cases.note: Unrounded price is 900 / 0.82 = 1,097.56. After rounding the margin is 18.18%, not exactly 18%, and must not be labelled as exactly on target.

cases.title: Target margin on a VAT-inclusive shelf price: convert first, round the shelf price
cases.note: Tax-exclusive target price 1,097.56 becomes 1,179.88 with VAT, rounded to 1,180. Margin on 1,180 / 1.075 is 18.0085%.

cases.note: 1,000 / 0.7 = 1,428.571…; rounded half-up to 1,428.57 the margin is 29.99993%. The guardrail must judge the final price, so this is a Breach.

cases.title: J1: one of the six SKUs that needs more than 12% to reach an 18% margin
J2: 25% markdown pushes margin below a 15% floor with Approval Escalation

cases.title: One record for this exact context is the Current Price
Two records for the same context at the same time: unresolved, never the newest
cases.note: Recording an implementation must end-date the old record, otherwise this is exactly what happens.

cases.title: Only another channel has a price: unavailable, not borrowed
